caption:
1,133 big Chicago building projects are still open in the City's permits, and every one names its builder.

That matters if you clean, wash windows or pressure wash. The general contractor buys the subcontracted work on each job, so the builder's office is the one to ask about cleaning.

From City of Chicago permits of $500,000 or more, issued in the last 24 months and still open:
335 new buildings and 798 renovations
The Loop leads with 160
21 have temporary or partial occupancy approved, so a final clean is close

Every number traces back to City permit records. We do the sorting so you don't have to. The free sample is in the first comment.
